note: Rank Up City: every building, its map spot, when it opens, its stages (max paws) and its album cards. Read by city.html and cards.html through EFA.registry() in assets/progress.js. To open a building: write games/<id>.json, record its clips, set ready: true here. A card needs: id, stage, name, rarity (COMMON RARE EPIC LEGENDARY SECRET), quote, and img or icon + color; perfect: true = a full score on that stage.

buildings.name: THE NEON CAFÉ
buildings.welcome: New in the city? Tap the Neon Café — the cyan one with the coffee sign. Dan needs a barista, and I need someone to judge.
buildings.allDone: Café Master. Hm. Not unimpressive. Head office is building the next floor. Until it opens, train at the Academy.

cards.name: NEON CUP
cards.quote: Full of potential. Refill and retry.

cards.name: MIA
cards.quote: The regular. Bright, kind, from Brazil.

cards.name: JACK
cards.quote: Big order, bigger heart. Cheers, mate.

cards.name: DAN
cards.quote: The manager on the radio. Believes in you.

cards.name: ENRI
cards.quote: I nap, and success finds me.

cards.name: VERA
cards.quote: One latte. And I am always watching.

cards.name: TOTTI
cards.quote: I observe. I judge. Then I nap.

cards.name: INSPECTOR VERA
cards.quote: Inspection passed. A perfect café.

buildings.name: THE OFFICE TOWER
buildings.teaser: The Office Tower — A2. Finish the Café first — beat the Inspection — and the lights come on. Almost there.
buildings.welcome: Café Master. Hm. Not unimpressive. And look — the Office Tower's lights just came on. Dan pulled some strings, got you a desk job. Go on, tap the gold building.
buildings.allDone: Café Master. Office star. Hm. I am almost proud. Head office is building the Detective Agency next. Until it opens, train at the Academy.

cards.name: OFFICE PASS
cards.quote: Everyone starts on day one.

cards.name: SOFIA
cards.quote: The team lead. Welcome aboard!

cards.name: MARCOS
cards.quote: The developer. Works from home on Fridays.

cards.name: LAURA
cards.quote: The client. Could you send the two plans?

cards.name: LAUNCH DAY
cards.quote: We're launching the app on Friday.

cards.name: THE DIRECTOR
cards.quote: Results. I like results.

cards.name: JOB OFFER
cards.quote: A perfect interview. You're hired.

buildings.name: THE DETECTIVE AGENCY
buildings.teaser: The Detective Agency — B1. Something's missing in the city. Beat the Office interview and the case is yours.
buildings.welcome: Office star. Hm. Now listen. Enri is missing. His cushion is still warm. I am not worried. I am... curious. Priya at the Detective Agency needs a partner. The purple building. Go.
buildings.allDone: Case closed. The cat is asleep on a room-service cart at the Grand Hotel, and I am not jealous. Head office is still building the next floor. Until it opens, train at the Academy.

cards.name: CASE FILE
cards.quote: Case one: a missing cat. Open.

cards.name: PRIYA
cards.quote: Has anyone seen Enri today? Let's go around the table.

cards.name: THE WITNESSES
cards.quote: I was drinking my tea when I heard a noise.

cards.name: THE EVIDENCE BOARD
cards.quote: He must be near. He might be in the box.

cards.name: THE DELIVERY BOX
cards.quote: Unless we hurry, we'll miss the truck.

cards.name: DETECTIVE TOTTI
cards.quote: I solved it. You helped. Slightly.

cards.name: ROOM SERVICE ENRI
cards.quote: The hotel has room service. I told you, kid.

buildings.name: THE CORPORATE VAULT
buildings.teaser: The Corporate Vault — B2. Locked tight. You'll have to talk your way out of this one.
buildings.welcome: Case closed. Good. Now the Corporate Vault has locked itself, with you on the inside. Figuratively. For now. The pink building. Bring a watch.
buildings.allDone: Out of the Vault before nine. Hm. Head office is still wiring the Radio Tower. Until it opens, train at the Academy.

cards.name: ACCESS BADGE
cards.quote: Access granted. For now.

cards.name: VAULT OS
cards.quote: Rewrite the sentence. Then the door opens.

cards.name: THE ARCHIVE
cards.quote: The files have been moved.

cards.name: THE RED BUTTON
cards.quote: He warned me not to touch it.

cards.name: WALT
cards.quote: If you were to sign the log, mate…

cards.name: THE FINAL DOOR
cards.quote: Five locks. One morning. Open.

cards.name: OUT BY MIDNIGHT
cards.quote: Not one second wasted.

buildings.name: THE RADIO TOWER
buildings.teaser: The Radio Tower — C1. My territory. You won't get in by tapping — you'll have to SPEAK.
buildings.welcome: The Vault is open and so, apparently, is the Radio Tower. The Signal needs a new voice. Not mine; I don't do mornings. The green building. Speak up.
buildings.allDone: Live at nine, and no dead air. Hm. The Grand Hotel is still getting ready for its summit. Until it opens, train at the Academy.

cards.name: PRESS PASS
cards.quote: Testing, one, two. This is The Signal.

cards.name: ALEX
cards.quote: You're on in ten. Breathe.

cards.name: THEO
cards.quote: Never have I seen such a crowd.

cards.name: THE CALLERS
cards.quote: Whaddaya wanna know?

cards.name: ROZ
cards.quote: We'll have to leave it there.

cards.name: THE ON AIR LIGHT
cards.quote: Red means live. Live means you.

cards.name: NO DEAD AIR
cards.quote: Three minutes. Not one second of silence.

buildings.name: THE GRAND HOTEL
buildings.teaser: The Grand Hotel — C2. The summit of the city. The guests up there... talk back.
buildings.welcome: The summit of the city. The Grand Hotel. The guests say less than they mean, the concierge says even less, and Enri lives there now, under a silver cover. The red building. Behave.
buildings.allDone: Graduate. Hm. Every building, A1 to C2. I have nothing left to judge. ...I will find something.

cards.name: MASTER KEY
cards.quote: Every door. Use it wisely.

cards.name: SOL
cards.quote: The room is… adequate.

cards.name: REX
cards.quote: Nine dollars for water. Is it famous water?

cards.name: JULIAN
cards.quote: Cut the furniture. Keep the grandmother.

cards.name: MS. WHITMORE
cards.quote: Make it shorter. Make it better.

cards.name: VERA'S FIVE STARS
cards.quote: Adequate. (From her, that is five stars.)

cards.name: GRADUATE
cards.quote: A1 to C2. The city is yours.
